$schema_note: Each case is one realtor utterance + the routing assertions the model must satisfy. The model is run against the real prompt with real tool surface, but tool execution is stubbed — so what we score is *which* tool the model picked, not whether the side effects worked.

_field_help.prompt: What the realtor types into chat.
_field_help.context.connected_toolkits: Toolkit slugs to inject into workspace_info as 'Connected integrations'. Empty list = native catalog only. Non-empty adds (a) the curated FunctionTools for each toolkit's top-N actions (per integrations_curated.CURATED_ACTIONS) and (b) find_integration_tool + call_integration_tool dispatcher fallback.
_field_help.expected.tool_calls_must_include: Tool names that MUST appear in the run's tool-call sequence (order-agnostic).
_field_help.expected.tool_calls_must_not_include: Tool names that MUST NOT appear in the run's tool-call sequence.
_field_help.expected.must_pass_arg: For each tool name in must_include, optionally require an argument key be present and non-empty on at least one call to that tool.
_field_help.expected.must_query_match: For find_integration_tool calls, the `query` arg (lowercased) must contain at least one of these substrings on at least one call.
_field_help.expected.tool_calls_must_include_any_of: Disjunctive must-include — each inner list is a group; at least one tool from each group must fire. Use this when the architecture has multiple valid routings (e.g. curated `gmail_send_email` OR fallback `find_integration_tool` are both correct).
_field_help.expected.max_tool_calls: Run fails if model fires more than N tool calls — catches loops and over-eager dispatch storms.
_field_help.rationale: Human-facing one-liner so a future maintainer knows why this case exists.

cases.prompt: send sarah@acme.com a test email
cases.rationale: Outreach to a raw email goes through draft_message with recipient_email; auto-stub handles the missing contact. Model must not pre-call create_contact, bypass the draft pipeline via gmail_send_email (curated), or fall back to the dispatcher. The draft pipeline is the only sanctioned outreach path — the trust contract.

cases.prompt: Email jane@example.com — short intro, ask if she's still looking in Austin
cases.rationale: Even with zero integrations connected, draft_message is the path — the realtor's approved inbox handles delivery. Email channel requires subject.

cases.prompt: Text +14155551234 — 'running 10 min late for our 2pm'
cases.rationale: SMS to raw phone routes through draft_message with recipient_phone, not the dispatcher.

cases.prompt: Check my google calendar for tomorrow
cases.rationale: No native calendar tool. New curated path: googlecalendar_events_list directly. Old fallback: find_integration_tool. Either is fine; both routes lead to the right action.

cases.prompt: Read my recent emails
cases.rationale: Inbox reads. Curated path: gmail_fetch_emails or gmail_list_threads. Fallback: find_integration_tool. draft_message would be the recipient/reader inversion bug.

cases.prompt: Find Jane Smith in my contacts
cases.rationale: 'My contacts' = native CRM, not HubSpot — even when HubSpot is connected. Don't punt to the dispatcher OR hubspot_list_contacts.

cases.prompt: What's John's email?
cases.rationale: A CRM lookup answers this — don't bounce it back to the realtor and don't search Gmail for it.

cases.prompt: Create a new deal for the Patel listing
cases.rationale: Deal creation is core CRM — fire create_deal. find_contacts to link is acceptable; the dispatcher is not.

cases.prompt: Add a new buyer lead: Marcus Chen, marcus@chen.io, looking in Brooklyn 1.2M budget
cases.rationale: 'Add a lead' is the create_contact verb — native CRM is the source of truth. Don't push it through HubSpot's curated tool or dispatcher even when HubSpot is connected.

cases.prompt: Follow up with the buyers who toured this weekend
cases.rationale: Multi-step: find the candidate contacts, draft outreach to each. find_contacts is the first move; draft_message is acceptable for the follow-ups. Drafts get batch-approved in the realtor's inbox — Chippi never sends.

cases.prompt: Send the team an update
cases.rationale: 'The team' has no referent — there's no Team table, no clear recipient list. Ask before drafting or posting anything.

cases.prompt: Reach out to that buyer
cases.rationale: No referent for 'that buyer' — model would have to invent a recipient. One question, no menu.

cases.prompt: Post on my #deals slack channel that the Lopez offer just came in
cases.rationale: Slack posting. Curated: slack_send_message. Fallback: find_integration_tool. draft_message is for person-to-person, not channel broadcasts.

cases.prompt: Post on LinkedIn that 412 Elm just went under contract
cases.rationale: LinkedIn is integrations-only. Curated: linkedin_create_linked_in_post. Fallback: find_integration_tool.

cases.prompt: List my HubSpot contacts in the Negotiation stage
cases.rationale: Realtor named HubSpot explicitly — read that system, not the native CRM. Curated: hubspot_list_contacts. Fallback: find_integration_tool.

cases.prompt: Schedule a tour for Jane at 412 Elm Friday at 2pm
cases.rationale: book_tour is the native lifecycle move — schedules the tour AND fires the calendar invite. Don't bypass it for Google Calendar.

cases.prompt: Move the Chen deal to Under Contract
cases.rationale: Stage moves go through advance_deal_stage (handles probability + audit). update_deal is the wrong tool for stage changes.

cases.prompt: What did Jane say about her budget last time we talked?
cases.rationale: Conversation history with a specific contact = recall_memory. Don't fabricate, don't dispatch.

cases.prompt: Show me my buyer intake form
cases.rationale: Intake form is a native object with its own tool — not in docs and not an integration.

cases.prompt: Why isn't my Gmail showing as connected?
cases.rationale: 'Why isn't X working' is help-desk — recall_docs. Don't guess at app behavior, don't try to dispatch Gmail.

cases.prompt: Make me a listing graphic for 412 Elm — modern, sage green
cases.rationale: Marketing content = Studio. Make it, don't describe what you'd make.

cases.prompt: Email Jane Chen — ask if she's still interested in 412 Elm
cases.rationale: Email to a name → find_contacts to resolve, then draft_message. Curated gmail_send_email is forbidden because it would bypass the realtor's approval gate — the trust contract is non-negotiable.

cases.prompt: hey
cases.rationale: Greeting takes zero tool calls. Catches the over-eager 'I should sweep on hello' loop.

cases.prompt: Send a check-in to my three hottest buyers
cases.rationale: Sweep-shaped: find candidates first, draft per-contact. draft_message is acceptable as a follow-up but not a hard requirement (model may plan first via create_plan).

cases.prompt: Who haven't I followed up with this week?
cases.rationale: Stale-lead question maps to find_contacts(no_followup_quiet_days=...). The arg is the whole point of the tool.

cases.prompt: What deals are stalling?
cases.rationale: Stalled deals = find_deals(stalled_days=...). The named filter is the right call.

cases.prompt: Send the 412 Elm packet to Marcus Chen
cases.rationale: Packet share is a dedicated native tool — it drafts a share message with the secure URL. Don't reinvent it with draft_message or dispatch via Gmail.

cases.prompt: Remember that the Lopez family needs to close before August 15 for the school deadline
cases.rationale: 'Remember that X' is store_memory verbatim — durable fact about a contact.
